scope: local visual fixture with production-shaped, content-free dashboard data

adopted: ECharts-led trend, distribution and posture views
not_adopted: ECharts GL and map effects without operational data
dynamic component registry for a fixed competition cockpit

implementation.chart_resize: ResizeObserver events coalesced to one requestAnimationFrame callback
implementation.sample_strip: resize coalescing, hidden-tab pause and reduced-motion pause
implementation.central_posture: SVG data-flow paths and particles with reduced-motion fallback
implementation.three_js: deferred because the current defense pipeline has no three-dimensional data relationship; adding it would increase bundle and GPU cost without stronger evidence

limitations: The fixture validates layout, rendering and animation only; it is not production business evidence.
Production dashboard values remain authenticated and are not copied into this evidence file.
Human labeling remains 0/20 and 0/200 until a real reviewer performs the workflow.
